tail:
**Batch 1 is authored.** The A item defines the total product on arbitrary functions and keeps the scalar product partial. The B example checks all four zero–infinity cases, all four sign combinations, and finite products. I created draft pages, dependency levels 0 and 1, source coverage, proof contracts, notes, and `ready` records for both items.

The owner’s all-functions interface supersedes the design’s measurable-input contract. I used the canonical B-page order 192.2 and recorded both reconciliations in the [batch notes](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/quantum-prerequisites-4-2026-10-15-batch-1.notes.md:1>).
